race.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
race.verdict: It could be worth chancing WE NEVER STOP , who often keeps better company and may be rekindled by the return to all-weather. Starmade is the obvious threat back at this venue after his encouraging third at Wolverhampton, with Lorna B another to consider having proved she's still on the upgrade after her comeback win last month. WE NEVER STOP (IRE) STARMADE (IRE) LORNA B (IRE)
